Daily Quiz.question: ১) 'Fools rush in where angles fear to tread' is stated by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Alexander Pope is a Mock Heroic Poet.
• His famous quotations:
- 'Fools rush in where angels fear to tread',
- 'A little learning is a dangerous thing',
- 'To err is human, to forgive is divine',
- 'An honest man is the noblest work of God',
- 'The proper study of mankind is man',
- 'Hope springs eternal in the human breast',
- 'Charms strike the sight but merit strikes the heart.'
Source: Merriam Webster Dictionary and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) 'Vladimir' is an important character of-

Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica and Waiting for Godot.

Daily Quiz.question:
৩) 'Alone, alone, all, all alone;
Alone on a wide, wide sea!
And never a saint took pity on
My soul in agony' is quoted by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Samuel Taylor Coleridge was a Romantic poet.
• He is known as 'Poet of Supernaturalism'.
• His famous quotations:
- 'Alone, alone, all, all alone;
Alone on a wide, wide sea!
And never a saint took pity on
My soul in agony'
- 'Water, water, everywhere;
And all the boards did shrink;
Water, water, everywhere;
Nor any drop to drink'
- 'He prayth best who loveth best, All things both great and small',
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) 'Speech is great, silence is greater' is stated by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Thomas Carlyle was a famous Scottish philosopher.
• His famous quotations:
- Speech is great, silence is greater.
- Popular opinion is the greatest lie.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) 'Friday' is an important character of-
Daily Quiz.exp:

- Xury,

- The Portuguese Captain.
Source: Robinson Crusoe and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) 'All the perfumes of Arabia will not sweeten this little hand' was quoted by William Shakespeare in-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Macbeth is a famous tragedy of William Shakespeare.

- 'All the perfumes of Arabia will not sweeten this little hand.'
- 'Fair is foul, and foul is fair.'
- 'Life is but a walking shadow.'
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) 'Mosca' is an important character of-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Ben Jonson is the second most important dramatist after William Shakespeare.
• He is called Father of English Realistic Comedy.
• His famous comedy is Volpone (The Fox).
• The important character of Volpone:
- Mosca,
- Celia,
- Bonario,
- Corvino,
- Volpone,
- Voltore.
Source: Volpone, Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) 'Poetry is the breath and the finer spirit of all knowledge' is taken from the writings of-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• William Wordsworth is a famous Romantic poet.
• His famous quotations:
- 'Poetry is the breath and the finer spirit of all knowledge',
- 'Poetry is a spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings'
- 'Ten thousand saw at a glance Tossing their heads in sprightly lance',
- 'Child is the father of man',
- 'Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting',
- 'Nature never did betray the heart that loved her',
- 'Come forth into the light of things, let nature be your teacher'.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) The famous character of Hamlet is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Hamlet is a famous tragedy of William Shakespeare.
• The important character of Hamlet:
- Ophelia,
- Hamlet,
- Claudius,
- Gertrude,
- Horatio,
- Polonius etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Hamlet.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) 'Fear not for the future, weep not for the past' is quoted by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• P. B. Shelley is a famous Romantic poet.
• His famous quotations:
- 'Fear not the future, weep not for the past',
- 'If Winter comes can spring be far behind?',
- 'The more we study, the more we discover our ignorance',
- 'Our sweetest songs are those that tell of saddest thought',
- 'Poets are the unacknowledged legislators of the world',
- 'I am the daughter of Earth and Water; And the nursling of the sky'.
Source: Queen Mab and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.exp:

- 'Necessity is the mother of invention' is quoted by Plato.
- Aristotle said, 'Man is by nature a political animal' (The Politics).

Daily Quiz.exp:
• Francis Bacon is The Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose.
• His famous quotations:
- 'Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed and some few to be chewed and digested.',
- 'A mixture of lie doth ever add pleasure',
- 'Silence is the sleep that nourishes wisdom',
- 'Revenge is a kind of wild justice',
- 'Opportunity makes a thief',
- 'It is impossible to love and be wise',
- 'History makes man wise'.
- 'Unmarried men are best friends, best Masters, best servants but not always best subjects',

Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) 'Cowards die many times before their death' was quoted by Shakespeare in-
Daily Quiz.exp:

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) 'Beware of false knowledge; it is more dangerous than ignorance' is quoted by-

- 'God is on the side of big battalions'.
- 'There are two tragedies in life, One is not to get your heart's desire and The other is to get it.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

- 'Where ignorance is bliss, it is folly to be wise',
- 'The paths of glory lead but to grave'.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica and Live MCQ Lecture.
